data.body:
CORRECTION — the commit SHA changed after my previous comment. Gerrit 1395 is now at
PATCH SET 2 = d57aa2a496 (PS1 was f078af4a65). Anyone tracing this work should follow PS2.

WHAT HAPPENED, and it was not me. After I reported, (a) my worktree was rebased onto
gerrit/main by an external process — reflog shows `rebase (start): checkout gerrit/main` —
and (b) Gerrit recorded "Uploaded patch set 2: Patch Set 1 was rebased. Copied Votes",
the signature of its SERVER-SIDE rebase. Both were done under the RebarBotNava identity,
which is the shared bot credential every agent on this host uses, so I cannot attribute it
further than that. Flagging it because I did not initiate it and other streams share this
credential; the rebase itself was benign and left the change better positioned.

MY WORK SURVIVED INTACT — verified, not assumed:
- 5 of 6 files are BYTE-IDENTICAL between PS1 and PS2 (compared via git hash-object).
- `_backend.py` differs only because UPSTREAM independently changed it (6 insertions,
  2 deletions between my old base fc705c6441 and the new base 3d203dc0d3). My own hunk is
  unchanged: the commit still adds exactly 24 lines there, and
  `class BackendPaginationStallError` is present at line 49.
- Change-Id I2631a983e4bdb095f9baf754e8336d8a53f65d3a preserved, so it is the same change.

RE-VERIFIED against the NEW base (3d203dc0d3 "259b: make capability-map staleness
checkable"), because my original gates ran against the old one:
- held-out oracle -> exit 0, 21 passed
- `make lint` -> exit 0
- `make typecheck` -> exit 0

GERRIT GATE STATE on PS2 — and the Verified vote is genuinely re-earned, not merely copied:
- LLM-Review +1 — COPIED from PS1 under the trivial-rebase copy condition.
- Verified — RESET on upload ("Patch Set 2: -Verified"), CI RE-RAN as a fresh job
  (run 30961282703) and returned Verified+1 SUCCESS. So CI has now validated this change
  against current main, independently corroborating the local gates above.
- unresolved comments: 0 | submittable: true | status: NEW (not submitted)

Still NOT submitted and the ticket stays in_progress, per the epic coordinator's instruction
to verify the acceptance criteria first.
